title: •Much Anger In Him
caption: •Much Anger In Him (V)
game_text: Use 4 Force to deploy on opponent’s non-droid, non-Jedi Master character (or 2 Force on a Rebel). Character’s game text is canceled and they draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Opponent may lose three cards from hand (may not be reduced) to cancel this Effect.
lore: “Adventure, heh. Excitement, heh. A Jedi craves not these things. You are reckless.”
